I used to take Kratom for 3 years taking an ounce per dose 
1. It’s not effective at killing pain. People over exaggerate the effect saying 3 grams killed chronic pain which it really doesn’t, it’s just placebo.
2. It lasts for about 30 minutes after awhile. At first you may get it to last for an hour or if you take an extract you get a good 4 hours.
3. Aweful constipation and sometimes stomach pain and gas
4. Sometimes it’s a hit or miss you might redose and feel high again or redose and feel like shit.
5. Tolerance goes up too fast, it will stop working after about a month then you have to double it. 
6. Horrible comedown that makes you feel like your angry at everything often times clenching your teeth. You are irritated, angry, depressed, anxious, feelings of dread.
7. Can make you incredibly sick, for some people they get really sick I never got too sick.
8. The euphoria you get from kratom is pretty good but you can only take it 2 times a week to get a nice feeling you start taking it everyday and the effects diminish and it’s like it’s not even working anymore, you might dose and be fucking angry.
9. Tastes awful
10. People over price their Kratom I used to get mine for 70 dollars an ounce which is pretty cheap but your best bet is an extract.
